_about: GTA VI native handlers named by behaviour (TASKS T1.6). Static analysis of the Xbox exe only; nothing here has been called in a game. Keyed by build: refuse this table on any other build (T2.3). rva = handler RVA; id = the 64-bit id the handler writes when called with argc < 0 (vi_script.h HandlerId), the key to match on other builds if ids prove stable (T3.2). args/ret are in 8-byte VM cells; params lists the argument types (entity and vector3 take 2 cells each, string is a System.String reference). namespace groups the generated wrappers (tools/docgen/gen_natives.js). confidence: high = the field or behaviour is proven by engine code; medium = behaviour proven, the GTA V name is an analogy; descriptive = VI-only behaviour, the name is ours. deny: true = the loader must never bind it.

GET_CLOCK_DAY_OF_WEEK.evidence: returns clock[+0x0] of ymmword_14AB5CDC0; +0x0 is the date field left over once day/month/year are placed (0x145351E40, 0x145351DF0)

GET_CLOCK_DAY_OF_MONTH.evidence: returns clock[+0x4]; day-of-year 0x145351E40 adds +0x4 to the summed month lengths

GET_CLOCK_MONTH.evidence: returns clock[+0x8]; 0x145351E40 sums days-in-month for months 0..[+0x8]-1, so 0-based

GET_CLOCK_YEAR.evidence: returns clock[+0xC]; 0x145351DF0 counts 365 + leap(y) for years 1970..[+0xC]

VI_GET_CLOCK_EPOCH_SECONDS.evidence: returns 0x145351DC0(&clock, 1970) = 86400 * days since 1970 + seconds of day, of the game clock

_GET_ASPECT_RATIO.evidence: returns dword_1492D7924 / dword_1492D7928, the width and height 0x141DE4030 sets from the display mode; GTA V's takes a bool, this one takes no argument

PRINTVECTOR.evidence: logs "<%f, %f, %f>;" from the 16 bytes at args (a Vector3 takes two slots)

PRINTSTRING.evidence: logs "%s;" with the text of a System.String reference (inline at +40, or behind a pointer when [+20] & 4)

PLAYER_PED_ID.evidence: command 0x145172940 returns entity_make_ref(qword_14AB56E38, out, 2). That global is a CPed object (its slot-71 component holds the current vehicle at +2200 and the last one at +2216, read by GET_PLAYERS_LAST_VEHICLE) and is cleared by 0x1427FA0E0

GET_PLAYERS_LAST_VEHICLE.evidence: command 0x1420F4B40: player object -> slot 71 (0x144DD7540) -> +2200 if the in-vehicle bit (byte +16 bit 5) is set, else +2216, as a reference

VI_GET_PLAYERS_LAST_VEHICLE_B.evidence: command 0x144AB1610 has the same body as GET_PLAYERS_LAST_VEHICLE's; a second command id for the same query

GET_ENTITY_COORDS.evidence: CEntity ref + 1 slot; command 0x140350100 -> 0x1403501B0 decodes object +0x70 with 0x144DC3790 and returns the 16-byte vector; arg 2 goes to 0x140350200 (the alive flag in GTA V, unverified)

GET_ENTITY_ROTATION.evidence: fwEntity ref + rotation order; 0x141B4F0D0 copies the matrix rows +0x40/+0x50 and the decoded position, then 0x141B4F1D0 converts to Euler angles by order (case 2 is the default)

GET_OFFSET_FROM_ENTITY_IN_WORLD_COORDS.evidence: command 0x141B4F130 = pos + o.x*row(+0x40) + o.y*row(+0x50) + o.z*row(+0x60), pos from +0x70 via 0x144DC3790; args are the ref and a Vector3

GET_OFFSET_FROM_ENTITY_GIVEN_WORLD_COORD.evidence: command 0x145B8F760 = dot(w - pos, each row): the inverse of GET_OFFSET_FROM_ENTITY_IN_WORLD_COORDS

GET_ENTITY_UPRIGHT_VALUE.evidence: command 0x142084980 returns float object+0x68 = up.z of the matrix, 0.0 for a null ref

GET_ENTITY_HEIGHT_ABOVE_GROUND.evidence: command 0x142084E30: decoded position z minus a ground probe (0x140039840); the bool arg adds a second probe path. GTA V's has no flag

VI_GET_ENTITY_BONE_POSITION_PACKED.evidence: CDynamicEntity ref + bone (-1 = entity origin); command 0x140A9D5A0 returns a 16-byte value packed by 0x1400E21D0 from the transform handle (+0x38) and the bone position. Like GET_WORLD_POSITION_OF_ENTITY_BONE, but the return is not 3 plain floats

GET_ENTITY_HEALTH.evidence: command 0x145DAB190: CDynamicEntity ref (IsA 0x291DD2F1) -> 0x1402BA4E0(obj, &health, &max), returns (int)health, clamped so that 0 < health < 1 reads 1

GET_ENTITY_MAX_HEALTH.evidence: CEntity ref -> 0x143C2FDF0: the same getter's second output, for entity types 2-4 (byte +0x30)

SET_ENTITY_HEALTH.evidence: command 0x143C273D0(ref, health >= 0, instigator ref, bool, bool): ped path (type byte 3) applies damage/health through 0x144BEFAE0; other types go to the ECS health component

SET_ENTITY_INVINCIBLE.evidence: command 0x143C26990: for peds toggles a proof flag 0x4839F0C7 on the ped's damage component; else entity flag 4

SET_ENTITY_COORDS.evidence: ref (2 cells) + Vector3 (16 bytes, 2 cells) + 4 bools + float, forwarded to the teleport 0x145C30320; behaviour of the flags not checked

DISABLE_CONTROL_ACTION.evidence: command 0x144BED290(group, control hash, bool): looks the control (atStringHash of an INPUT_* name) up in the pad's control map (0x140B1B050) and disables it for this frame (0x14198C8A0)

ENABLE_CONTROL_ACTION.evidence: command 0x144BECC40: same lookup as DISABLE_CONTROL_ACTION, then re-enables (0x141ACAC90)

IS_CONTROL_PRESSED.evidence: command 0x140B1AFB0(group, control hash): control map lookup, then the input's pressed state (0x1452D2970)

GET_GAME_TIMER.evidence: returns (int) the low dword of the game timer block xmmword_14ABBEF40

GET_FRAME_TIME.evidence: returns float +0xC of the same timer block

GET_PLAYER_WANTED_LEVEL.evidence: CPed ref (0x14526E340) -> player info (0x144F68B80 by ECS id) -> u32 +24364

CLEAR_PLAYER_WANTED_LEVEL.evidence: CPed ref -> 0x143EB8530: resets the wanted component (0x145828B60(w, 5, 0)) when the ped has one

SET_CLOCK_TIME.evidence: command 0x143CDE5E0(h, m, s, bool): 0x14263A630 rebuilds the game clock ymmword_14AB5CDC0 with h:m:s (seconds of day % 86400)

SET_WEATHER_TYPE.evidence: command 0x143E950F0(weather hash, ...): finds the hash in the weather type table (0x141CD5210, remaps applied) and sets it now or over transition time * 1000 ms

_GET_NUM_FREE_SLOTS_IN_PED_POOL.evidence: 0x144E4BC50: capacity - pool_peds +0x10 (used count), clamped at 0; confirms qword_14ABB6918 is the ped pool
